summary: Full backend + Streamlit UI e2e test of RAG Evaluation System. 13/13 backend pytest cases passed and end-to-end UI flow verified (query -> grounded answer with [chunk N] citation -> retrieved context -> metadata badges + Langfuse trace link). All 5 integrations verified with real outputs: OpenAI gpt-5.4-mini via Emergent proxy (grounded answers), MiniLM local embeddings (384-dim), Pinecone (15 vectors indexed), Langfuse (real UUID trace_ids returned), RAGAS (real 0-1 float scores for faithfulness/answer_relevancy/context_precision on both testset and recent scopes).
critical_code_review_comments: Streamlit text_area value is only committed to session_state on blur or Ctrl+Enter; automated testing needs to send Ctrl+Enter before clicking Ask, but human users pressing 'Ask' will trigger blur automatically so this is not a real UX issue.

In server.py, keyword-mode bm25 branch does a per-context Mongo lookup to backfill source/section/chunk_index. This is correct but O(N) round-trips; consider a single db.chunks.find({_id: {$in: ids}}) batch when top_k grows. Not blocking.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - should migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager in future. Non-blocking (still works).

Delete-by-source path does not verify Pinecone actually acknowledged delete before rebuilding BM25; if Pinecone raises, the doc still gets removed from Mongo. Consider try/except and returning partial-failure status.
seed_data_creation: 4 markdown seed docs re-ingested via /api/documents/seed (already pre-seeded; endpoint is idempotent). 8-item golden testset served by /api/testset. Test-created conversation IDs left in Mongo (they are namespaced with TEST_persist prefix in the query text).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend on 8001 via supervisor, Streamlit on 3000 via `yarn start` -> streamlit. All endpoints under /api. Pinecone index 'rag-eval-index' dim=384 serverless aws us-east-1. Health endpoint reports {mongo_docs, mongo_conversations, pinecone.total_vectors, langfuse_configured}. Streamlit uses text_area for query input; for Playwright, ALWAYS press Ctrl+Enter after fill() before clicking Ask to commit the value. Real trace_id UUIDs observed in /api/conversations (e.g. a1a466e4-7553-...). RAGAS eval on scope=testset limit=3 took ~15-20s and returned real numeric aggregates (faithfulness=0.72, ans_rel=0.25, ctx_prec=0.33 in one run). Key selectors that work on Streamlit UI: `.answer-box`, `.chunk-card`, `button[role='tab']:has-text('Chat'|'Documents'|'Evaluation Dashboard'|'Query History')`, `[data-testid='stSidebar']`, `button:has-text('Ask')`.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found. First iteration required a Ctrl+Enter step in the Playwright script because Streamlit text_area session-state commit semantics; that is a test-script fix, not an app bug.
